svg.title: A Blast Radius incident, replayed
svg.desc: A terminal running a supply-chain incident: transitive exposure, semver resolution, a live OSV lookup and the fix, each carrying the latency of the query that produced it. Typeset in Space Grotesk and JetBrains Mono, SIL Open Font License 1.1.
svg.text: 27k lines / 381 tests / MIT / built solo over a hackathon weekend
